reviews.review: my homie wont stop talking about it
Hella fun easy to get caught up and forget time, played this game for 5 hours strait without realizing

I started playing Warframe years ago and i have many fond memories of coming home from school and booting up my ♥♥♥♥♥♥ pc and playing the game at 24fps.
I was drawn to the game because it was cool space ninjas. What kept me playing was the amazing gameplay. Warframe really fuels your power fantasy, you really feel like this overpowered cool ninja person. The gunplay is satisfying and the melee weapons are mostly satisfying as well.
I personally really like the grinding aspect of the game, how could you not? it gives you an excuse to play more!
One of the best parts of the game is the economy, being able to farm items and then sell  them on a market is amazing. I will admit i have spent around 100-200$ on the game over all my years of playing. And i never regretted it. You get a cool new weapon or cosmetics and u get to support the devs.
The story is also really interesting, especialy the newer updates have been more and more story focussed.
My one real negative point is the amount of new content added in the frequent updates. "How could more content be a bad thing?"shhhh
It's not bad, new stuff is always good. However, if you havent played in a while its really hard to get into the newer stuff. I have 770+ hours played and i have not played with Rivens or custom weapon crafting mechanics yet. because for example to craft a weapon, there is so so so much stuff you need to do. Get your level up with the earth settlement, farm specific things, farm more specific things. and each of the open world planets has its own version of this. I feel overwhelmed while playing because there is simply so so so so so much to do.
I very much reccomend it however.

This game turned me transfem, 10/10, hard to get into but once you do its extremely fun, also a game that truly deserves the free to play title, with microtransactions not being remotely required to have fun
